decision.reason: No new material semantic failures in this fresh run. D08 correctly conveys accusation in both rounds, so the field-level regression in the rejected local-example-repair candidate is absent. Missing phrase IPA and existing minor omissions/awkwardness remain disclosed.
decision.scope: Acceptance concerns observed semantic compatibility of the final pipeline on this fixed corpus, not a claim of universally perfect translation or attribution of quality gains to diagnostics/performance changes.

comparison.d08: Both fresh outputs correctly say accusation; historical failure should remain a regression case because identical settings do not guarantee identical future model output.

missingIpa: D11 give up and D12 take off, both repetitions; no attested whole-phrase entries in either dialect
limits: 24/24 acceptable core semantics applies only to these 12 fixed cases repeated twice under the existing rubric. It allows minor non-core omissions and awkwardness and is not a perfect-translation score. Complete cards remain 20/24 because IPA is missing for two phrases. Keep earlier failed D08 outputs as stability evidence.
